svg.title: Bloomberg AI and ML cases: three modes by three periods, one representative case per cell
svg.desc: Eight representative Bloomberg cases, one per populated mode-by-period cell, drawn from the eleven systems this paper traces. Arranged as three mode blocks by three period columns. Each case is broken into business problem, inputs, action, outputs, destination, platform build and notes. Silences in the record are marked. The agentic middle period holds no case.
svg.text: One structure, eight of eleven cases shown
Three modes down, three periods across, one representative case per populated cell. Every case broken on the same seven slots. Marked silences are properties of the record, not of the system.

Purple predictive, green generative, gold agentic. A case appears once, in the mode row chosen as its exemplar.
Peer-reviewed, engineering post, press release, marketing. Read the PLATFORM BUILD row against this chip, never alone.
Deployed, research only, not deployed. A published paper is not evidence of deployment.
▲ red = a silence in the record.
Not a property of the system. An empty field and a stated zero are different things and are worded differently.
Red dashed line = ChatGPT's public release.
